contradiction_resolution: No claim-level contradiction: contradicts_claim_ids is empty and the statement does not oppose CONJ-0001, THM-0001–THM-0007, OBS-0001, or RED-0001. It is required by and compatible with THM-0005/SRC-0002 Table 1 and Proposition 4.5: M_{g,n} has CKgP and A^*=R^* (hence pure-weight Tate by Lemma 4.3) only for n≤c(g), with c(6)=5, so M_{6,5} is covered while M_{6,6} and an unidentified CE-surjective open U⊂M_{6,6} are outside the published range. Primary permanence (SRC-0004 Lemmas 3.2–3.10 / SRC-0002 Prop. 4.2) transfers CKgP to opens of CKgP spaces and down proper surjections, but does not license CKgP for U from CKgP of M_{6,5} without identifying U with a space/map in the permanence calculus; ATT-0034’s cited M_{6,5} dependency is therefore mis-scoped. Independently consistent with corroborated FND-0055 (CE syzygy vanishing on U is not a purity/Tate theorem) and with RED-0001 residual status of (6,6). Distinct from FND-0055 (vanishing vs. undischarged CKgP identification), so not a merge. Promote from candidate obstruction to corroborated for C66-FULL localization routes that discharge U by CKgP.
